evaluations.employee_area_of_development: Significant improvement is required in leadership effectiveness, initiative, HR process compliance, quality of work, communication accuracy, and HR system proficiency. Greater accountability, ownership, and proactive management of HR activities are needed to meet the expectations of the HR Manager role.
evaluations.employee_improvement: Focus on improving leadership and people management skills, strengthening knowledge and use of HR systems, enhancing the quality and timeliness of HR deliverables, and taking greater initiative in resolving HR-related issues. Develop stronger planning, delegation, and decision-making capabilities to improve departmental performance.
evaluations.employee_strength: Demonstrates professionalism and maintains respectful working relationships with colleagues and employees. Possesses a basic understanding of HR processes and continues to support routine HR operations. Maintains acceptable standards of conduct and contributes positively when assigned responsibilities.
evaluations.direct_manager_comments: Jackline Kirumaghio demonstrates professionalism and maintains positive working relationships within the organisation. However, performance during this evaluation period indicates a need for substantial improvement in leadership, work quality, HR process compliance, communication accuracy, and system utilization. Greater ownership, accountability, and proactive management of HR functions are required to effectively meet the expectations of the HR Manager position.
evaluations.evaluator_comment: The overall score of 50/100 reflects performance below the expected standard for an HR Manager. While there are strengths in professional conduct and basic HR process knowledge, improvement is required in leadership, initiative, quality of deliverables, communication, compliance, and system competency. A structured Performance Improvement Plan (PIP) with clearly defined KPIs, monthly reviews, and targeted development objectives is strongly recommended.

evaluations.employee_area_of_development: The evaluation indicates significant development is required in leadership effectiveness, strategic planning, service provider management, communication, and cross-functional collaboration. Greater focus is needed on driving engineering initiatives, enforcing compliance standards, managing contractor performance, and improving coordination with internal departments. The low scores in leadership, communication, and strategy suggest a need for stronger managerial presence and proactive operational oversight.
evaluations.employee_improvement: Develop and implement a structured engineering strategy aligned with organisational objectives, strengthen service provider monitoring through clear KPIs and SLAs, and improve reporting accuracy and responsiveness to client escalations. More attention should be given to policy compliance, team engagement, delegation, and data-driven decision-making to improve overall departmental performance.
evaluations.employee_strength: Demonstrates a reasonable understanding of maintenance operations, PPM planning, asset management, and reactive maintenance processes. Despite challenges in strategic and leadership areas, maintains acceptable attendance and continues to support day-to-day engineering operations. Maintenance and asset management performance was the strongest area of the evaluation.
evaluations.direct_manager_comments: Azlan Ahamed continues to support the engineering function and maintain operational activities across facilities. However, the evaluation reflects performance below the expectations of a Head of Engineering role. Improvement is required in strategic leadership, service provider management, team development, communication, and operational governance. Greater ownership of departmental objectives, improved contractor oversight, and more proactive leadership are expected during the next review period.
evaluations.evaluator_comment: The overall score of 48/100 indicates that performance is currently below the required standard for a department head position. While operational maintenance activities are being managed at an acceptable level, there are substantial gaps in leadership, strategic direction, communication, compliance management, and stakeholder engagement. A structured improvement plan with clear performance objectives, leadership coaching, and quarterly performance reviews is strongly recommended.

problem solving, and leadership effectiveness. Greater focus is needed on risk 
management, process improvement, and strategic IT oversight.

maintenance processes, increase proactive identification and resolution of IT issues, 
and strengthen leadership skills through better team supervision, delegation, and 
decision-making.
evaluations.employee_strength:
Demonstrates good professional conduct, maintains satisfactory attendance, and 
provides consistent support for daily IT operations. Shows a sound understanding of

departments
evaluations.direct_manager_comments:
Sharstan demonstrates commitment to daily operational responsibilities and maintains 
professional working relationships. However, performance during this review period 
indicates significant improvement is required in leadership, cybersecurity governance, 
infrastructure management, and proactive problem resolution. Greater ownership, 
accountability, and strategic direction are expected from an IT Manager role.
evaluations.evaluator_comment:
The overall score of 52/100 reflects performance below the required standard for an IT 
Manager position. While the employee demonstrates acceptable professionalism and 
operational support capabilities, improvement is required in leadership, cybersecurity, 
infrastructure management, initiative, and strategic IT planning. A structured 
performance improvement plan with measurable objectives and quarterly reviews is 
recommended

evaluations.employee_area_of_development: Requires improvement in procurement process knowledge, initiative, work quality, time management, system proficiency, and compliance with procurement procedures. Greater ownership and accuracy are required to achieve departmental expectations.
evaluations.employee_improvement: Focus on strengthening procurement process knowledge, improving understanding of company SOPs and purchasing procedures, enhancing ERP/Odoo system skills, reducing errors in daily work, and demonstrating greater initiative in resolving procurement-related issues independently
evaluations.employee_strength: Demonstrates positive professional conduct and maintains respectful working relationships with colleagues. Cooperates effectively with team members and shows willingness to support departmental activities. Maintains acceptable communication skills and contributes to routine procurement operations as assigned.
evaluations.direct_manager_comments: Arunima demonstrates professionalism and maintains positive working relationships within the team. However, improvement is required in procurement process understanding, work accuracy, timeliness of deliverables, initiative, and system utilization. Greater attention to detail, compliance with procedures, and proactive engagement in procurement activities are necessary to improve overall performance.
evaluations.evaluator_comment: The overall score of 50/100 reflects performance below the expected standard for the Assistant Purchase position. While the employee demonstrates acceptable teamwork and professional conduct, significant improvement is required in procurement knowledge, work quality, initiative, compliance, and technical system competency. A structured development and coaching plan with measurable improvement targets is recommended.

evaluations.employee_area_of_development: The main development areas are initiative, problem-solving, teamwork, documentation accuracy, customer follow-up, and system utilisation. Greater focus is needed on taking ownership of customer concerns, improving accuracy in records and reports, and working more collaboratively with colleagues and other departments.
evaluations.employee_improvement: Improve responsiveness to customer requests, strengthen follow-up practices, and enhance proficiency in CRM/ERP systems to ensure accurate data entry and reporting. Myla should demonstrate greater initiative in identifying and resolving issues independently and contribute more actively to team objectives.
evaluations.employee_strength: Maintains acceptable attendance and punctuality, demonstrates professional conduct with customers, and shows a responsible approach towards assigned duties. Possesses a basic understanding of customer service processes and can perform routine responsibilities when given guidance
evaluations.direct_manager_comments: Myla Jane Romulo Montenegro maintains a professional attitude and completes assigned tasks; however, overall performance remains below expected standards for the role. Improvement is required in teamwork, initiative, customer follow-up, documentation accuracy, and effective use of company systems. Consistent coaching and closer monitoring are recommended to support performance improvement.
evaluations.evaluator_comment: The evaluation reflects a need for improvement across several key performance areas. While the employee demonstrates reliability in attendance and basic customer service duties, performance gaps exist in problem-solving, collaboration, reporting accuracy, and system knowledge. A structured development plan with clear performance targets should be implemented during the next review period

evaluations.employee_area_of_development: Procurement strategy development, vendor management, contract administration, policy compliance, procurement reporting, and analytical decision-making require significant improvement to meet the expectations of the Procurement Manager role
evaluations.employee_improvement: Strengthen procurement planning and forecasting processes, improve supplier performance management, enhance contract negotiation effectiveness, implement measurable cost-saving initiatives, and utilise procurement analytics and KPIs more effectively to support strategic purchasing decisions
evaluations.employee_strength: Demonstrates good knowledge of procurement systems and maintains acceptable control over day-to-day procurement operations. Effectively communicates with internal stakeholders and suppliers and shows reasonable capability in financial control activities and procurement administration
evaluations.direct_manager_comments: Rateb demonstrates commitment to operational procurement activities and maintains good working relationships with suppliers and internal stakeholders. However, improvement is required in strategic procurement planning, vendor management, compliance, reporting, and cost optimisation. Greater focus on proactive sourcing strategies, supplier performance evaluation, and procurement governance is necessary to achieve departmental objectives
evaluations.evaluator_comment: The overall score of 51/100 reflects performance below the required standard for a Procurement Manager position. While the employee demonstrates satisfactory operational procurement knowledge, communication skills, and ERP system competency, significant improvement is required in procurement strategy, vendor management, compliance, reporting, and cost-saving initiatives. A structured development plan with measurable procurement KPIs, cost reduction targets, and quarterly performance reviews is recommended

evaluations.employee_area_of_development: The primary development areas are customer communication, issue resolution, documentation accuracy, CRM/ERP system usage, and proactive problem-solving.  Greater attention is needed in handling customer inquiries professionally, providing accurate information, and ensuring timely follow-up on customer concerns
evaluations.employee_improvement:
Focus on improving customer service standards, enhancing communication skills, 
maintaining accurate customer records and increasing proficiency in CRM/ERP systems. Develop a more proactive approach to identifying and resolving customer issues without excessive supervision. Regular coaching and performance monitoring 
should be implemented to strengthen service delivery
evaluations.employee_strength: Demonstrates acceptable attendance and punctuality, maintains professional conduct with customers, and shows accountability in assigned responsibilities. Able to support team members and contribute positively to workplace professionalism.
evaluations.direct_manager_comments:
Faith Cherotich demonstrates commitment to attending work and maintaining 
professional behaviour; however, performance in key customer support functions remains below expectations. Significant improvement is required in customer communication, issue resolution, reporting accuracy, system utilisation, and independent problem-solving. Consistent coaching and closer performance monitoring are recommended to achieve the expected service standards.
evaluations.evaluator_comment:
Performance Improvement Plan is required. The evaluation reflects performance gaps across most key areas, particularly customer interaction, 
documentation, communication, and system knowledge. A structured improvement plan with measurable KPIs, weekly performance reviews, and targeted training should be implemented over the next quarter. Continued employment should be assessed based on demonstrated improvement against agreed objectives.

evaluations.employee_strength: Demonstrates strong commitment to engineering operations and maintains effective coordination with internal departments and service providers. evaluations.direct_manager_comments: Azlan Ahamed continues to maintain stable engineering operations and demonstrates commitment to departmental responsibilities. Positive contributions are evident in operational alignment, teamwork, and leadership. To achieve a higher performance level, emphasis should be placed on asset management, service provider governance, maintenance effectiveness, reporting standards, and strategic utilisation of engineering systems.

evaluations.employee_area_of_development: Improvement is still required in issue resolution, follow-up efficiency, escalation judgement, documentation accuracy, and proactive problem-solving. Stronger ownership of customer concerns and better utilisation of CRM systems will help improve service quality and customer satisfaction.
evaluations.employee_improvement: Focus on resolving customer issues more promptly, improving follow-up consistency, strengthening escalation decision-making, and enhancing CRM/ERP system utilisation. Developing a more proactive approach to identifying customer needs and preventing recurring service issues will further improve overall performance.
evaluations.employee_strength: Demonstrates strong attendance and punctuality, maintains professional interactions with customers, and shows a positive attitude toward customer service responsibilities. Customer communication has improved, and the employee maintains acceptable standards of teamwork and compliance with company procedures.
evaluations.direct_manager_comments: Myla demonstrates reliability, professionalism, and improved customer communication. However, additional improvement is required in issue resolution, follow-up management, escalation accuracy, and documentation quality. Greater initiative, accountability, and proactive customer service are expected to further improve performance and customer satisfaction.
evaluations.evaluator_comment: The overall score reflects performance that partially meets expectations and has improved compared to the previous quarter. A structured development plan with measurable service KPIs and regular coaching is recommended.

evaluations.employee_strength: Demonstrates professionalism, maintains positive working relationships, communicates clearly, and shows good judgement in handling workplace issues. Possesses solid foundational HR knowledge and adapts well to company systems and processes.

However, performance remains at a satisfactory level, and greater initiative, accountability, and consistency are required to meet the expectations of an HR Manager role. Focus should be placed on strengthening HR process execution, improving follow-up, and driving department improvements proactively.
evaluations.evaluator_comment: Retain with Performance Improvement Plan and Development Objectives. The employee demonstrates potential and possesses key professional strengths; however, measurable improvement is required in HR operations management, leadership effectiveness, process compliance, and proactive decision-making. A review period of 3-6 months with clearly defined KPIs is recommended.

evaluations.employee_area_of_development: Further development is required in customer service excellence, independent problem solving, and effective utilisation of CRM/ERP systems. evaluations.employee_improvement: Continue building confidence in handling customer enquiries independently, improve response times, and focus on enhancing documentation accuracy and system proficiency. Developing stronger analytical skills to identify customer trends and recommending service improvements will contribute to higher performance levels
evaluations.employee_strength: Demonstrates reliable attendance and punctuality, improved teamwork and collaboration, positive professional conduct, and stronger communication skills. Faith Cherotich has shown measurable improvement during this evaluation period,

evaluations.employee_improvement: Continue strengthening procurement process knowledge, enhance attention to detail to reduce rework, improve proactive problem-solving abilities, and take greater initiative in managing procurement tasks independently. evaluations.employee_strength: Demonstrates good professional conduct, accountability, and cooperation with colleagues. Shows improving knowledge of procurement procedures and company systems and contributes positively to procurement operations. Displays willingness to learn and adapt while maintaining acceptable accuracy in daily procurement activities
evaluations.direct_manager_comments: Arunima has shown noticeable improvement compared to the previous review period, particularly in procurement process understanding, system utilization, and professional conduct. Continued focus is required on quality of work, accuracy, initiative, and independent task management to further enhance performance and support departmental objectives.
evaluations.evaluator_comment: The overall score of 62/100 reflects satisfactory performance and demonstrates positive improvement from the previous evaluation period. The employee has made progress in procurement knowledge, system usage, collaboration, and professional conduct. Continued development in work quality, initiative, problem-solving, and task ownership is recommended to achieve a higher level of performance and readiness for increased responsibilities.

evaluations.employee_area_of_development: The primary development area is procurement governance and analytical capability. Greater attention is required in procurement record accuracy, audit readiness, spend analysis, reporting quality, and the use of procurement data to support business decisions. Compliance controls and documentation standards should be strengthened to minimise operational and audit risks
evaluations.employee_improvement: Focus on implementing stronger procurement controls, maintaining complete and accurate procurement records, improving supplier performance monitoring, and increasing the use of procurement analytics to identify cost-saving opportunities. Procurement reporting should become more data-driven, with measurable KPIs and regular management reviews.
evaluations.employee_strength: Demonstrates solid leadership and workload management abilities, with strong responsiveness to internal stakeholders and effective supplier communication. Maintains acceptable procurement planning and inventory coordination practices and shows good proficiency in ERP and procurement systems
evaluations.direct_manager_comments: Rateb Alzeer demonstrates commitment to daily procurement operations and maintains constructive working relationships with internal stakeholders and suppliers. Leadership and coordination skills are evident; however, greater focus is needed on procurement controls, compliance documentation, reporting accuracy, and strategic cost management to improve departmental performance and support business objectives more effectively.
evaluations.evaluator_comment: Recommendation: Retain with Performance Improvement Objectives for Q3. Rateb Alzeer shows capability in leadership, supplier coordination, and operational procurement activities; however, measurable improvement is required in audit readiness, procurement record management, spend analysis, and reporting effectiveness. A structured improvement plan with procurement KPIs and quarterly review targets is recommended.

supervision, performance management, delegation, and developing a more proactive 
management approach. Improvement is also needed in IT infrastructure oversight, 
cybersecurity controls, and service delivery standards to achieve higher operational 
performance
evaluations.employee_improvement:
Focus on implementing structured IT governance, improving helpdesk response and 
resolution times, strengthening documentation standards, and enhancing preventive 
maintenance practices. Greater initiative in identifying risks and driving continuous 
improvement projects will contribute to stronger departmental performance
evaluations.employee_strength:
Demonstrates good attendance, professionalism, technical system knowledge, and 
effective communication. Shows capability in proposing practical solutions and 
maintains stable day-to-day IT operations while supporting business systems 
effectively
evaluations.direct_manager_comments:
Sharstan Batal maintains a professional attitude and possesses the technical 
knowledge required for the role. However, performance remains at an average level 
across most evaluation areas. Greater focus is required on leadership, team 
development, cybersecurity management, operational efficiency, and proactive planning 
to meet the expectations of an IT Manager position
evaluations.evaluator_comment: Recommending retaining with Performance Improvement Objectives for the Next Quarter. Sharstan has demonstrated adequate technical competence and reliability but requires measurable improvement in leadership capability, IT service management, security governance, and team supervision. Specific KPIs should be established for infrastructure performance, service responsiveness, cybersecurity compliance, and team development, with a formal review at the end of the next quarter
